description: Primary listing-discovery tool for homes in Singapore. Use this when the user asks what properties are available, or describes a home to buy or rent by area, MRT station, budget, bedrooms, flat type or other criteria. Omit query for a broad availability request; query is full-text search over project, title, address and description. pagination.total is the exact number of matching listings. Returns summaries of active, published Homejourney listings that may be shown in AI assistants: price, size, address, nearest MRT, nearby schools, a Homejourney link and a link to book a viewing, but never the owner or agent contact details.

available_from.description: The renter's move-in date. Matches homes available on or before it, and homes that state no date.

bathroom_counts.description: Exact bathroom counts to match; combines with bathrooms_min.

bedroom_counts.description: Exact bedroom counts to match, such as [2, 3]; 0 is a studio. Combines with bedrooms_min, so [0] plus bedrooms_min 5 means studio or 5+.

districts.description: Singapore postal districts, such as "D09" or "15".

furnishing.description: The furnishing the renter wants. Matches homes stated as this, and homes that state no furnishing.

hdb_flat_types.description: HDB flat types, such as "4-room" or "executive".

lease_duration_months.description: The renter's lease length in months. Matches homes whose minimum lease is at most this, and homes that state no minimum.

listed_by.description: Who lists the home. owner keeps homes their owners list: on Homejourney, or on HDB Flat Portal without an agent. agent keeps every other home. pagination.total counts only these homes.

mrt_lines.description: MRT or LRT lines; a listing matches when its nearest station is on one. Combines with mrt_stations as 'near any'.

mrt_stations.description: Nearest MRT station names, such as "Orchard" or "Tanjong Pagar".

pets_allowed.description: true for a renter with a pet. Leaves out homes that say no pets; homes that state no pet policy still match, so confirm it with the lister.

psf_max.description: Price per square foot in SGD.

psf_min.description: Price per square foot in SGD.

reachable_only.description: Only homes whose owner or agent can be reached now: a viewing request reaches the owner or a Homejourney agent, or the lister takes WhatsApp. Leaves out homes whose agent is not on Homejourney yet and has no verified WhatsApp number. pagination.total counts only these homes.

sort.description: newest is the recommended order; listed_newest is strictly by listing date.

towns.description: HDB towns, URA planning areas or URA regions the listing lies in, such as "Tampines", "Bukit Timah" or "East". A region (Central, East, North, North-East, West) covers all its planning areas.

utilities_included.description: true for a renter who wants utilities in the rent. Leaves out homes that say utilities are extra; homes that do not say still match, so confirm it with the lister.

name: search_listings

bathrooms.description: The whole home's bathrooms; for a let room, read room.ownBathroom.

bookingUrl.description: Where the user asks for a viewing. Absent when that page takes no request: the owner books on a portal (reach.bookOn says where) or no request reaches anyone.

depositMonths.description: Details and compare, for an owner rental: the security deposit in months of rent, as the owner stated it. Null when not stated; partner listings carry none.

descriptionSource.description: Who wrote description: generated means Homejourney wrote it from the listing's photos and data, so say so when quoting it and never present it as the lister's words; listing means the lister wrote it; null with no description.

facing.description: Details only: which way the main windows face, as the owner states it (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW).

floorplans.description: Details only: published floor plan image URLs.

hdbFlatType.description: For an HDB flat in search, details and compare: its flat type, such as 4-room or executive, inferred from its block's resale records and its size. Absent when no single type matches, so treat that flat's type as unverified and never infer it from bedrooms.

hdbLease.description: Details and compare, for an HDB flat: its block's lease start year, the lease left this month and the block's age in years, as in lease; kept for earlier clients. Null when unknown.

houseRules.description: Details and compare: the house rules the listing states, such as {"pets": false, "cooking": true} (true allowed, false not allowed) or rules in words such as ["no_smoking"]. An owner rental may add "tenants", who the owner says the home suits (families, couples, working_professionals, students); none is no preference. Empty or null when it states none.

imageLabels.description: One per image, in order: the tag to show with an owner's edited photo, or null for an unedited one.

lease.description: Search, compare and details, for every home: its tenure, the lease left this month and its age from TOP, as the listing page shows them. An HDB flat's lease comes from its block's resale records; a condo, EC or landed home's from URA's records of its land lease, not its TOP. remainingLabel is 'Lease start not confirmed' for a leasehold whose start is not found, and null for freehold and 999-year homes. Null when nothing is known.

startYear.description: The year the lease began; null when not confirmed.

tenureLabel.description: Such as 99-year lease from 2000, or Freehold; null when the tenure is not known.

listedAt.description: When the listing was first shown publicly.

maxOccupants.description: Details only, for a rental: the most people who may live in the home or room, 1 to 20. Null when not stated.

nearbyPlaces.description: Details only: the places the listing page shows near the block. mrtStations (code, name, walkMinutes), futureStations (stations under construction within 1.5 km: name, lines, openingYear as LTA expects it or null when not dated, walkMinutes), primarySchoolsWithin1Km and primarySchools1To2Km (the Primary 1 registration bands), secondarySchools, supermarkets, hawkerCentres (within 2 km) and clinics (CHAS clinics within 1 km, type gp or dental), the last three with name, place and walkMinutes, parks (NParks parks within 1 km of their nearest edge: name, areaHectares, walkMinutes) and malls (shopping malls within 2 km from OpenStreetMap: name, walkMinutes; credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors" when you show them), each with distanceKm. Distances are straight-line from the block and walks are estimates; for Primary 1 registration, the user checks the exact distance on OneMap SchoolQuery.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

priceReason.description: Details only: the owner's own words on why the home is priced as it is.

renovationYear.description: Details only: the year the owner last renovated.

reportUrl.description: Details only: for an owner listing, the listing page with its Report this listing form open, where the user tells Homejourney the details or photos are wrong, it isn't the owner's, it's gone or it looks like a scam. The user sends the report themselves; null for other listings.

room.description: For a rental that lets a master room, common room or bed space: the room itself, which its card shows in place of the flat's bathrooms and floor area. Null for a whole home, a studio or a sale.

label.description: Master room, Common room or Bed space.

ownBathroom.description: True for an attached bathroom, false for a shared one, null when not stated.

squareFeet.description: The room's own size; null when not stated, never the flat's.

seller.description: Details only, for an owner listing: whether the owner verified with Singpass, their weekly viewing hours (Singapore time, weekday 0 is Sunday; empty when none are open), and how many minutes they usually take to first answer a viewing request (null until they have answered at least 3).

squareFeet.description: Floor area. An owner's let room gives the flat's here; read room.squareFeet for the room's own size.

storeyRange.description: Details only: HDB's three-storey band, such as 13 to 15, never the exact storey.

utilitiesIncluded.description: Details only, for a rental: whether the rent includes utilities (true) or not (false). Null when the listing does not say.

featured.description: Labelled Pro listings matching the search, on page 1 only.

nextSteps.description: Suggestions for what the user usually does next, best first. Each names the tool to call or the page to open; none is taken without the user asking, and a tool that writes still needs their confirmation.

resultReason.description: Why the search found no listing, or that it searched a corrected term.

unappliedIntent.description: Words in query that an explicit filter replaced; those words were not searched.
